tokens.name: cl-brand-teal
tokens.usage: The logo teal. Reserved for AI-related features and agent affordances — never generic chrome. 4.44:1 on `cl-surface`, 4.76:1 on `cl-surface-pure`, 3.78:1 on `cl-surface-warm`: below the 4.5:1 floor on the first and third, which is the source's own value and is kept exact — set small teal text on `cl-surface-pure`, or carry it at 19px+ bold / 24px+.

tokens.name: cl-brand-navy
